params.prompt: Marcus should compare both policies before giving up his old coverage. He needs to understand whether the new coverage is effective, what guarantees change, which costs restart and how existing loans affect the result. Changed health can affect new underwriting. A replacement may meet a real need, but a sales illustration alone is not a complete comparison. Maryland also exempts specified transactions from this chapter, such as certain contractual conversions. Identify the scope before applying a deadline. The professional goal is an informed decision supported by accurate documents, not replacement for its own sake.
